answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to post a refundable stake that is slashed on proven misbehavior, while new entrants pass through a single slow inlet: one verified onboarding per day, tied to a unique hardware-backed key. Like tending an orchard, reputation grows only through sustained honest work; a relic account that goes idle loses its standing through decay, so attackers cannot stockpile cheap identities and must pay real time and capital for each one.
